### Clear post-v0.17.0 drift and fix the prefix-ULID log corruption  ·  P1  ·  1 of 5 done  ·  feature 1 / bug 2 / ops 2
After v0.17.0 shipped, a sweep of the work log against the actual repo found four items that no longer match reality — a closed-out release still marked open, a finished epic still open and therefore invisible on the roadmap, a session health check that cries wolf on every start, and two abandoned worktrees. It also turned up hard evidence that a known bug has already corrupted this repo's own work log: closing an item by the short id the tool prints creates a phantom item instead. This plan clears the drift and fixes that bug at its root.
